mintAuthority.summary: SAFO's Ethereum token and Permission Manager are UUPS-upgradeable, with the PM ADMIN group controlled by a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe at 0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea. Pinned block 26095796 confirms that token mint permission accepts ADMIN or group 2. The removed historical EOA 0x60a98f4b7d6e3f0b71d9ad3dd74b6a416f00c84a is not the complete mint-group census: six contract addresses currently hold group 2, including the verified native Minter proxy 0x5ed5a75eeed1934ea060186e35187eaa73331366. Two group-10 EOAs can initiate native minting through this proxy within a shared 5000000-share daily limit; six group-9 EOAs and a 1-of-4 Safe can approve pending mints without that daily-limit check. ADMIN can raise the limit or upgrade the token, PM and Minter, so these operational controls do not bound ultimate mint capacity. Five additional group-2 contracts return BurnWithFromMintTokenPool 1.6.1 and identify other configured fund tokens, not SAFO, at Ethereum block 26098894. Their broad PermissionManager mint grant is retained as observed; configured-token-only execution still requires deployed-source equivalence before they are removed from the unresolved native-path candidates. Solana native issuance is now traced at finalized slot 452345677: the configured admin vault is a 1-of-1 Squads path, and its sole member also retains the minter program upgrade authority. These are verified single-signature controls; daily operational limits are bypassable through admin approval and replaceable by a program upgrade.

controls.label: Spiko token minter role (governed by Permission Manager)
controls.evidence: Spiko's token is a UUPS-upgradeable ERC-20 whose privileged functions (including mint/burn) are governed by a central Permission Manager; Spiko, as transfer agent for the SICAV, mints fund shares on KYC-gated subscription at the published NAV.

controls.label: Spiko Permission Manager ADMIN group — Ethereum (6-signer legacy multisig, threshold 3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25576670, authority() on SAFO ETH token 0xcbade7d9 returned PM 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472. getRequirements on the PM returned the ADMIN group mask for upgradeToAndCall on both the token and PermissionManager; getGroups() resolves this multisig to that ADMIN group. getOwners() returned 6 signers and getThreshold() = 3. The token and PermissionManager have EIP-1967 implementation slots 0xbf5fb9284c9cf2798d5f18a9702af620cd4351be and 0xd3f5f1524e1a472b51374a3ff41b8936eb5b658e respectively, with zero EIP-1967 admin slots, so this group is the UUPS upgrade control.

controls.label: Spiko native Minter proxy — Ethereum group 2
controls.capDescription: Pinned dailyLimit(SAFO) is 500000000000 raw shares (5000000 shares at decimals 5), and maxDelay is 86400 seconds. initiateMint requires ADMIN or group 10; exceeding the daily limit creates a pending request. approveMint requires ADMIN or group 9 and executes a pending mint without the daily-limit check. setDailyLimit requires ADMIN. These mutable, bypassable operational limits do not bound ultimate ADMIN mint or upgrade power.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095796, PM getGroups(proxy) includes group 2 and canCall(proxy, SAFO token, mint selector 0x40c10f19) returned true. The Minter proxy authority is PM 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472, its implementation slot is 0xd4f4fb505b8c3c3cf3c39947246b2cafa10fe043, and the corrected EIP-1967 admin slot is zero. PM getRequirements(proxy, upgradeToAndCall) returned ADMIN mask 1; the fetched verified implementation calls token.mint in initiateMint and approveMint.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25576670: SAFO token authority = PM 0x344278aff. The PM ADMIN group 0 resolves to 0x4eaa52b6, a 6-signer legacy multisig with threshold 3. The PM requires that ADMIN group for upgradeToAndCall on both the token and PermissionManager; both are UUPS proxies with zero EIP-1967 admin slots. Group 2 (previously EOA 0x60a9, now removed via remGroup tx history) remains a separate mint group. Per-chain PM state differs; this verification covers the Ethereum deployment. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: CACEIS independently calculates daily fund NAV and PwC performs four statutory audits per year; the latest holdings data disclosed by Spiko was updated 2026-03-03. The AMF GECO registry matches the exact Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund containing USD share class FR0014015LE1. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: unbounded Permission Manager mint and upgrade authority; existing periodic fund reconciliation and AMF product supervision remain supported.
